name: Tuck Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your legs together and arms reaching overhead.
Brace your abdomen and lift your heels just clear of the floor.
Simultaneously curl your head and shoulders upward while tucking both knees tightly toward your chest, wrapping your arms beside or around your shins.
Pause briefly in the tight tuck, then extend your arms and legs slowly back out just above the floor.
tips: Keep your lower back anchored toward the ground when extending out rather than letting it arch harshly.
Exhale forcefully as you draw your chest and knees together.
